//: Typechecking for the specs, which the build config MUST exclude — they would otherwise be emitted into dist and published. Extends BOTH: the build config, so strictness here can never drift from what ships; then ../../tsconfig.spec.base.json, which carries the few settings that must differ because vitest, not Node, loads these files (and the workspace-package-to-source map both it and vitest read). Later entries in an `extends` array win, so the spec base's overrides sit on top.
